description: This Java class 'FormulasPane' is part of a user interface module that displays mathematical formulas related to engine tuning parameters. It constructs a GUI component that updates automotive engine formulas based on sensor data and user controls, rendering LaTeX formulas with jlatexmath. The class interacts with external protocols, sensor data, and configuration fields, and provides functions for rendering different engine load modes.

classes.name: FormulasPane
classes.description: A JPanel-based GUI component that displays real-time engine formulas using LaTeX rendering and provides controls for saving images and pausing updates.

methods.name: FormulasPane
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the GUI components, buttons, periodic updates, and internal state.

methods.name: updateFormula
methods.description: Fetches sensor data and configuration, computes engine load formulas, and renders them as LaTeX images in the GUI.

methods.name: getAccelerationVariables
methods.description: Generates LaTeX-formatted acceleration variables based on current sensor values.

methods.name: getSpeedDensity
methods.description: Constructs the LaTeX formula for Speed Density engine load mode, using sensor data and configuration.

methods.name: getInjecctorLag
methods.description: Returns a LaTeX string representing the injector lag calculation based on battery voltage.

methods.name: oneDecimal
methods.description: Formats a double or sensor value into a one-decimal string.

methods.name: twoDecimals
methods.description: Formats a double or sensor value into a two-decimal string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel component containing the formulas display.
